title: Individualized care, consistent interface
intro: A single reference for colors, typography, brand and components across the health-care professional panel (HCP), admin, login, patient app and the Takere website.
hero: Tokens, HeroUI components and usage guidelines for building welcoming, clear and accessible screens — in light and dark, on any screen size.

care.title: Empathy
care.body: Patients and professionals use Takere in sensitive moments. A human tone, calm colors and no unnecessary visual alarms.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: One primary action per screen, status always shown with icon and text, and an obvious typographic hierarchy.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.body: The same tokens and components across every product, so each screen feels part of the same family.

explore.title: Explore
explore.description: Start with the foundations, then see how they apply to components.

items.colors: Brand palette, semantic tokens and HeroUI mapping.
items.spacing: Spacing scale, radius, shadows and breakpoints.
items.icons: Phosphor Icons, weights, sizes and care icons.
items.forms: Text fields, select, checkbox and switch.
items.patterns: Page header, empty state and responsiveness.

theme.title: Light and dark
theme.body: Light is the default theme. Dark is defined on the same tokens — switch it at the top of the page.

i18n.title: Three languages
i18n.body: Portuguese, English and Spanish — the same languages as the professional panel.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.body: From phone (360 px) to desktop. On phones, navigation opens in a side drawer.

stack.title: Tech stack
stack.description: The same libraries used in Takere's frontends.
